name: io.github.Scrape-Technology/abrasio-mcp
title: Abrasio
description: Stealth browser for AI agents: navigate, click, type and extract on bot-protected sites.

environmentVariables.name: ABRASIO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Abrasio cloud API key (abr_live_...). Omit to run in free local mode. Get one at https://scrapetechnology.com/abrasio/register

environmentVariables.name: ABRASIO_REGION
environmentVariables.description: Target region for locale, timezone and cloud IP, e.g. BR or US

environmentVariables.name: ABRASIO_HEADLESS
environmentVariables.description: Run the browser headless (true) or with a visible window (false)
